id: title:eli-r-ph:log every deletion of a revived person

review.posthog_relevance: Adds version-based deduplication and a 24-hour window to person deletion activity logging, reducing redundant database writes and potential race conditions during account deletion. P1.F1.H6 implements the version comparison and state tracking.
review.reason: The change replaces a 1-hour window and set-based deduplication with a 24-hour window and version-based deduplication for person deletion activity. P1.F1.H6 explicitly checks recent ActivityLog entries and stored tombstone versions, adding `_logged_deletion_versions` and `_deletion_already_logged` to prevent duplicate logging. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and resource
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the implementation being complete and the versioning strategy being compatible with existing deletion workflows, which is not independently verified. No tests or rollback checks are visible in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary/generated-only hunks. No score assigned.
